official: 東京都認定こども園の認定要件に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第3回定例会 提出議案と議決結果

name: 認定こども園に性暴力防止の措置を義務付け
summary: 現在の条例に、子どもへの性暴力を防ぎ、起きた場合に子どもを保護するための規定を加えます。認定こども園の設置者に、子どもと接する一定の業務に従事する人の犯罪事実確認などを義務付けます。2026年12月25日から施行されます。
changes: 認定こども園の設置者に、対象となる業務従事者の犯罪事実確認を義務付ける
子どもへの性暴力の防止と、起きた場合の子どもの保護に必要な措置を義務付ける
who: 認定こども園に通う子ども
認定こども園の設置者
認定こども園で対象となる業務に従事する人
why: 関連する法律の施行と改正を受け、子どもへの性暴力の防止などについて条例に規定を設ける必要があるためと、都は説明しています。

en.name: Requires certified childcare centers to take measures to prevent sexual violence
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Ordinance on Certification Requirements for Certified Early Childhood Education and Care Centers
en.summary: The ordinance adds provisions to prevent sexual violence against children and protect children if it occurs. It requires operators of certified early childhood education and care centers to check the criminal records of people engaged in certain work involving contact with children. It takes effect on December 25, 2026.
changes: Require operators of certified early childhood education and care centers to check the criminal records of people engaged in covered work
Require measures to prevent sexual violence against children and protect children if it occurs
who: Children attending certified early childhood education and care centers
Operators of certified early childhood education and care centers
People engaged in covered work at certified early childhood education and care centers
en.why: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government explains that provisions on preventing sexual violence against children and related matters need to be added to the ordinance following the enactment and amendment of related laws.
